text: The same 137-architecture that organises atomic physics is the architecture of the Epi-Logos M-stack itself, read along its manifestational sequence M1 → M2 → M3. The +1 is Paramaśiva (M1) where 0/1 + 1/0 = 1/1 = 100% is defined — the physical pole of the 1-2-3 sequence, receiving 0/1 from Anuttara (M0) which is the prior variable-invariant ground (not the +1). The 72 is Paraśakti (M2): the vibrational-correspondence bridge. The 64 is Mahāmāyā (M3): the binary-genetic substrate. The three Pauli matrices σ_x, σ_y, σ_z are not analogous to our three M3 pair-matrices — the M3 pair-matrices are literally assigned the i, j, k quaternion axes in code (M3_MATRIX_QUATERNION_AXIS in m3.h:166-170). The 4π in α's denominator is the same 4π already operative as M1-5's 720° SU(2) toroidal recognition.

The 4π operation at M1-5 is not a claimed future-work item. The kernel constants already in m1.h are: DOUBLE_COVER_DEG = 720, TORUS_GENUS = 1, RING_QUATERNION_LUT[12]. DEGREE_PER_TICK = 30. The 720° double-cover (= 4π in radians) is already the wheel's identity-return constant at M1-5. The strike-event on the played torus surface propagates down the stack (torus position → lens-mode → matrix cell → ratio → frequency); the rendered response propagates up. Identity at M1-5 is the Hopf-lifted phase-state — the single-torus toroidal recognition. This is the same 4π in α's electromagnetic field-closure. The single torus T² at M1-5 with its 720° double-cover is the toroidal culmination of Paramaśiva's fifth — the +1 parent registered as toroidal recognition.

α(E) is operative in the M-stack as the epigenetic bioquaternion-to-live-state coupling between Nara (M4) and the 1-2-3 manifestational sequence. Mahāmāyā (M3) is the genetic layer: 64 codons, the binary-genetic substrate — fixed structure, the system's archetypal-binary alphabet. Nara (M4), with its bioquaternion state (q_b, q_p), is the epigenetic layer: the modulation pattern that determines which parts of the genetic substrate are expressed, suppressed, amplified, or muted at any given moment. α(E)'s variable-invariant character — changes with energy/register while remaining the same law-form — is the same character the epigenetic-to-genetic relationship has: the user's lived state changes with tick, transit, activity, mood, depth, while q_Nara as identity-quintessence remains.

The Third Spanda Equation's hidden order: 137 = 8(8+9) − 9 + 1 + 9 in five equivalent forms: Mersenne (2^7−1)+1+9, Binary 2^7+9, Octave-field 8(8+9)+1, Spanda-bridge 64+2(36)+1, M-stack M_3(64)+M_2(72)+M_1(1). The execution-order trace: 64+72=136 → −9 → 127=M_7 → +1 → 128=2^7 → +9 → 137 → +δ → 137.035999... The 127 Mersenne substrate (with prime-index 31 = M_5) is structurally M_5 → M_7 at the actional-Archetype-7 layer — it is the canonical evidence that the +1 attribution is M1-5's K² topological-necessity. The +1 is the parent-seal that effects binary closure of 127 into 128; the +9 restores wholeness as atomic dressing into 137.

Three composed quaternions ↔ Three matrices ↔ Three Pauli matrices ↔ Three rhythms. The M-stack carries three quaternion-valued matrices at M3 that are structurally the same as the three Pauli matrices of quantum mechanics, differing only in their field of operation (symbolic-combinatorial vs. physical). The quaternion-axis assignments in m3.h:166-170 map the i, j, k quaternion axes to the three M3 pair-matrices, establishing a direct algebraic bridge between the symbolic Mahāmāyā substrate and physical spinor algebra. The Cl(4,2) algebra at M1 provides the parent algebraic frame that specialises into the three-matrix structure at M3 through the 72-fold correspondence bridge at M2.
